hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: The chart is cropped at the bottom cutting off the visualization, and the bundled edges converge into an illegible black mass at the center — both are functional failures that prevent reading the data encoding despite reasonably clean UI chrome.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest throughout: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout node radii and sunburst ring scaling, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions present on both node and link joins, no bar/area baseline violations, and no dual-axis fabrication — minor caveat is purely synthetic data with no real quantitative encodings to stress-test.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The tension slider's `.transitioning` guard is broken (no element ever gets that class), so redrawLinks fires unthrottled on every input event; no `.interrupt()` is called before new transitions so rapid layout switching leaves position state inconsistent; and mouseover/drag handlers have no touch vs. mouse filtering.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout switching keeps working memory load low and the 3-color node palette is clear, but the control panel crowds 8 layout buttons plus 4 secondary controls creating UI overhead, and the bundled edges converge into a dense central tangle in circle-pack mode that obscures individual link paths.
